theory.example: The teacher enters the classroom and says, “Hello, everyone. Please take your seats.”
At the start of the first lesson, the teacher says, “Good morning, everybody. Are you ready?”
After lunch, the teacher greets the pupils: “Good afternoon, class. Let’s get started.”
The teacher asks the group, “How are you getting on with your project?”
Looking out of the classroom window, the teacher says, “What a lovely day! The sun is shining.”
The teacher smiles at a pupil and asks, “How are things with you, Alex?”

theory.en: Are you feeling better today, David?
theory.ru: Ты сегодня чувствуешь себя лучше, Дэвид?
theory.example: David was ill yesterday, so the teacher asks, “Are you feeling better today, David?”
As the class comes in with wet umbrellas, the teacher says, “What a rainy day!”

theory.en: Today is very cold, isn't it?
theory.ru: Сегодня очень холодно, не правда ли?
theory.example: Before the lesson, the teacher remarks, “Today is very cold, isn't it? Keep warm!”

theory.en: My name is Mr/Mrs/Ms Smith. I'll be teaching you English this year.
theory.ru: Меня зовут мистер/миссис/мисс Смит. В этом году я буду преподавать вам английский язык.
theory.example: On the first day, the teacher introduces themself: “My name is Ms Smith. I'll be teaching you English this year.”

theory.ru: Я ваш новый учитель английского языка.
theory.example: Meeting the class for the first time, the teacher says, “I'm your new English teacher.”

theory.en: I've got five lessons with you each week.
theory.ru: У нас с вами будет пять уроков в неделю.
theory.example: Explaining the timetable, the teacher says, “I've got five lessons with you each week.”
When the bell rings, the teacher says, “Let's begin today's lesson. Open your notebooks.”
After greeting the class, the teacher says, “Let's begin our lesson now.”

theory.en: I think we can start now.
theory.example: Once everyone is seated, the teacher says, “I think we can start now.”
Before explaining the task, the teacher asks, “Is everybody ready to start?”

theory.en: Now we can get down to work.
theory.ru: Теперь мы можем приступить к работе.
theory.example: After a short warm-up, the teacher says, “Now we can get down to work.”

theory.en: It's time to begin, please stop talking.
theory.example: As the class settles, the teacher says, “It's time to begin, please stop talking.”

theory.en: I'm waiting for you to be quiet.
theory.ru: Я жду, когда вы успокоитесь и перестанете разговаривать.
theory.example: When several pupils are still chatting, the teacher says, “I'm waiting for you to be quiet.”

theory.en: Settle down now so we can start.
theory.example: The teacher asks the class, “Settle down now so we can start.”

theory.en: We won't start until everyone is quiet.
theory.ru: Мы не начнём, пока все не успокоятся.
theory.example: The teacher reminds the group, “We won't start until everyone is quiet.”
As the lesson starts, the teacher says, “Stop talking and be quiet, please.”
Looking around the classroom, the teacher asks, “Who isn't here today?”
While taking the register, the teacher asks, “Who is absent today?”

theory.en: Why were you absent last Friday, Tom?
theory.ru: Почему тебя не было в прошлую пятницу, Том?
theory.example: When Tom returns to class, the teacher asks, “Why were you absent last Friday, Tom?”

theory.en: What's the matter with Anna today?
theory.example: Noticing that Anna looks upset, the teacher quietly asks, “What's the matter with Anna today?”

theory.ru: Что сегодня не так с Анной?
theory.example: When Anna seems unwell, the teacher asks a colleague, “What's wrong with Anna today?”

theory.en: We started ten minutes ago. What have you been doing?
theory.ru: Мы начали десять минут назад. Чем ты занимался всё это время?
theory.example: A pupil arrives late, and the teacher says, “We started ten minutes ago. What have you been doing?”
When a pupil arrives late in the morning, the teacher asks, “Did you oversleep?”
Seeing that a pupil is late, the teacher asks, “Did you miss your bus?”
A pupil comes in after the bell, and the teacher asks, “Where have you been?”
After listening to the explanation for being late, the teacher says, “Don't let it happen again.”
